title: Section
description: A section within a canonical document. Represents a structural subdivision such as an article, paragraph, or chapter.

section_id.description: Unique identifier for the section. Format: sec_{ulid}

parent_section_id.description: ID of the parent section, if this is a nested section. Null for top-level sections.

title.description: Title or heading of the section.

ordinal.description: Position of this section within its parent (0-indexed).

depth.description: Nesting depth of the section (0 = top-level).

section_type.description: Classification of the section type (e.g., article, paragraph, chapter).
